construction-chemicals.title: BOYSEN ® ® Plexibond™ B-7760 Cementitious Waterproofing System
construction-chemicals.surfacePrep: BOYSEN ® ® Plexibond™ should be applied on bare concrete, wood, or metal that has not been previously painted. Existing paint should be totally scraped off. New masonry should be allowed to cure for at least 14-28 days. The surface should be clean, free from oil, grease, dust, dirt, and any loose grit or mortar. Dampen concrete surfaces first with water before applying Plexibond mix to avoid abrupt drying and cracking of the applied modified cement, especially under hot and sunny conditions.
construction-chemicals.materialPrep: Slowly mix 6.5-7.5 kilograms of cement to 4-Liters of BOYSEN ® ® Plexibond™ while constantly stirring to prevent lumping. Pass the mixture through a fine strainer to sift out lumpy materials. Ensure intimate mixing, stirring as often as possible to avoid settling. Keep mixture proportion constant for a uniform texture. Mix only enough material to prevent waste. Workability of Plexibond mixture is 30 minutes, while the potlife is 2 hours.
construction-chemicals.appSchedule: For vertical surfaces such as firewalls, apply one coat of Plexibond mixture using a textured roller (for orange peel texture finish) or two coats by brush (for plain finish) while maintaining coverage rate at 5-6 square meters. Recoating interval is 1-2 hours. For filling large cracks, add 3 parts by volume of fine, uniform-sized sand to 1-part cement and mix with Plexibond to a trowellable consistency. Suggested topcoats are BOYSEN ® ® Permacoat™ Latex, BOYSEN ® ® Acrytex™, BOYSEN ® ® Acqua Epoxy™, or BOYSEN ® ® Epoxy Enamel. Allow Plexibond to dry for at least one day before paint application. For horizontal surfaces such as roof decks, parapets, canopies, and ledges, slowly mix 6.5 kg cement to 4-Liters Plexibond and apply 3-5 coats by brush or 2-3 coats by textured roller. construction-chemicals.title: Konstrukt™ Durafill™ K-101 Gypsum Putty and K-103 Fast-Setting Gypsum Compound
construction-chemicals.surfacePrep: Surface should be clean and dry, free from dust, dirt, and other foreign matter.
construction-chemicals.materialPrep: Mix 9-Liters of clean water with 20-kg of K-103 Fast Setting Gypsum Compound until a lump-free homogenous paste is achieved. Use of power mixer is recommended for optimum results.

construction-chemicals.title: Konstrukt™ K-630 Join "N" Seal Hybrid Polyurethane Sealant
construction-chemicals.surfacePrep: The key to long-term sealant and adhesive performance is proper substrate preparation. The substrate must be clean, dry, and free of any oils, greases, incompatible sealers, paints or coatings that may interfere with adhesion and good joint performance. Porous surfaces should be cleaned of dust and debris from fabrication or job site dirt before cleaning using a stiff brush or using oil and moisture free compressed air. Mechanical methods, such as wire brushes or grinders, may be required to remove surface contamination, debris, and failed sealants such as in re-caulking applications.

construction-chemicals.title: Konstrukt™ Permaplast™ K-231 Deco Render
construction-chemicals.surfacePrep: Make sure that the surface is clean and dry, free from oil, grease, dust, dirt, and other foreign matter.
construction-chemicals.appSchedule: Apply K-231 Deco Render onto the substrate by using a stainless steel trowel. The finish should be troweled lightly to the thickness of the largest aggregate. If a circular texturing is desired, use a trowel or float. Maintaining a wet edge float finishes 5-8 minutes after the initial application. Let the product cure overnight prior to the application of a topcoat. For MSDS requests, please email technical@boysen.com.ph Pacific Paint (BOYSEN) Philippines, Inc. construction-chemicals.title: Konstrukt™ Permaplast™ K-222 Interior Render
construction-chemicals.surfacePrep: Surface should be clean and dry, free from oil, grease, dirt, contaminants, and all loose grit and mortar. Always dampen the concrete before application. Plastered walls should already be cured for at least 14-28 days prior to the application of the interior render.
construction-chemicals.materialPrep: Mix Konstrukt™ Permaplast™ K-222 Interior Render (25-kg bag) with 5.5 Liters of water in a clean container. Using a mixing device, stir until trowelable consistency is attained. Take note that once mixed, the product should be used within 1-2 hours. Avoid adding water into mixture that has begun to set as it will weaken product properties.
construction-chemicals.appSchedule: Using a steel trowel, apply the mixture on uneven surfaces, initially on surfaces with deep openings not more than 8mm in depth. Let the product dry for an hour before applying the second coat, if necessary. For a smooth finish, apply Konstrukt™ Permaplast™ K-201 High-Performance Acrylic Skimcoat over K-222 Interior Render after K-222 has cured for 3 days. For MSDS requests, please email technical@boysen.com.ph Pacific Paint (BOYSEN) Philippines, Inc. Pacific Paint ( BOYSEN ® ) Philippines, Inc. is the leading paint manufacturer in the country, supplying both architectural paints and construction chemicals to both local and international markets.

construction-chemicals.title: Konstrukt™ Permaplast™ K-220 Interior Superfine White Skimcoat & K-252 Interior Skimcoat Sealer
construction-chemicals.surfacePrep: Check and repair all relevant defects by consulting necessary civil works. Make sure that the surface is clean and dry and is free from dirt and oil prior to application. Always dampen the concrete substrate before application. Plastered walls should already be cured for at least 14-28 days prior to the application of the skimcoat.
construction-chemicals.materialPrep: Mix 20-kgs of K-220 Interior Superfine White Skimcoat with 7- Liters of waters in a suitable container until a lump-free homogenous paste is reached. Only mix enough product that can be used within 30 minutes working time. Avoid adding water to the mixture that has begun to set.
construction-chemicals.appSchedule: Using a steel trowel, apply the mixture thinly on the surface by pressing the edge of the trowel firmly on the concrete substrate until all areas are covered. Let it dry for at least 1 hour before applying the second coat, if necessary. If trowel marks are visible, let surface dry for at least 1 hour before sanding to further smooth surfaces. For MSDS requests, please email technical@boysen.com.ph Pacific Paint (BOYSEN) Philippines, Inc. Pacific Paint ( BOYSEN ® ) Philippines, Inc. is the leading paint manufacturer in the country, supplying both architectural paints and construction chemicals to both local and international markets.

construction-chemicals.title: Konstrukt™ Permaplast™ K-210 Acrylic 2K Skimcoat
construction-chemicals.surfacePrep: Surface should be clean and dry, free from oil, grease, dirt, contaminants, and all loose grit and mortar. For previously painted concrete surfaces, make sure the paint has been completely scraped off.
construction-chemicals.materialPrep: Mix 4-Liters of K-210 Acrylic 2K Skimcoat Part A (Liquid) per 28-kg bag of K-210 Acrylic 2K Skimcoat Part B (Powder) and 8-Liters of water on-site into a clean plastic or aluminum container. Using a mixing device, stir the mixture until it is free of any lumps. Mixture can be used within a 1-2 hour working time. No other material should be added into the mixture.
construction-chemicals.appSchedule: Using a steel trowel, apply a thin layer of mixture on the surface by firmly pressing the edge of the trowel on the concrete until all areas are covered. Let it dry for at least 1 to 2 hours before applying the second coat, if necessary. If trowel marks are visible, let surface dry for at least another 30 minutes before sanding to further smoothen surfaces. No need to neutralize. Allow at least 7 days curing time before painting the desired topcoat. For MSDS requests, please email technical@boysen.com.ph Pacific Paint (BOYSEN) Philippines, Inc. construction-chemicals.title: Konstrukt™ Permaplast™ K-202 High-Performance Acrylic Render
construction-chemicals.surfacePrep: Surface should be clean and dry, free from oil, grease, dirt, contaminants, and all loose grit and mortar. Always dampen the concrete before application. Plastered walls should already be cured for at least 14-28 days prior to the application of the render.
construction-chemicals.materialPrep: Thoroughly mix K-202 High Performance Acrylic Render in its container. Afterwards, transfer the product to a suitable container and mix it with sifted cement at a 1:1 ratio by weight until a lump-free, homogenous paste is achieved. Do not add water. Use Portland cement (for ordinary cement color) or white cement (to produce a white finish).
construction-chemicals.appSchedule: Using a steel trowel, apply a thin layer of mixture on the surface by firmly pressing the edge of the trowel on the concrete until all areas are covered. Let it dry for at least 1 hour before applying the second coat. If trowel marks are visible, let surface dry for at least another hour before sanding to further smoothen surfaces. Allow at least 7 days to cure before painting. No need to neutralize. For MSDS requests, please email technical@boysen.com.ph Pacific Paint (BOYSEN) Philippines, Inc. construction-chemicals.title: Konstrukt™ Permaplast™ K-201 High-Performance Acrylic Skimcoat
construction-chemicals.surfacePrep: Surface should be clean and dry, free from oil, grease, dirt, contaminants, and all loose grit and mortar. Defects on concrete like plumbness that are more than 3mm thick should be addressed by using exterior renders. Always dampen the concrete before application. Plastered walls should already be cured for at least 14-28 days prior to the application of a skimcoat.
construction-chemicals.materialPrep: Put K-201 High-Performance Acrylic Skimcoat in a suitable container and mix it with sifted cement at a 1:1 ratio by weight until a lump-free, homogenous paste is achieved. Do not add water. Use Portland cement (for ordinary cement color) or white cement (to produce a white finish).
construction-chemicals.appSchedule: Using a steel trowel, apply a thin layer of mixture on the surface by firmly pressing the edge of the trowel on the concrete until all areas are covered. Let it dry for at least 1 hour before applying the second coat. If trowel marks are visible, let surface dry for at least another hour before sanding to further smoothen surfaces. Allow at least 7 days before painting. No need to neutralize. For MSDS requests, please email technical@boysen.com.ph Pacific Paint (BOYSEN) Philippines, Inc. construction-chemicals.title: Konstrukt™ Sealtite™ K-501 2-pack Cementitious Waterproofing
construction-chemicals.surfacePrep: Surface should be clean and dry, free from oil, grease, dirt, contaminants, and all loose grit and mortar. For previously painted concrete surfaces, make sure that the paint has been completely scraped off.
construction-chemicals.materialPrep: 1. Mix 12-Liters of K-501 Waterproofing Part A (Liquid) with 28-Kg of K-501 Waterproofing Part B (Powder) in a clean plastic or aluminum container. 2. Using a mechanical device, stir until the mixture is lump-free. 3. Mixture can be used within a 1-2 hour working time. Avoid the addition of water into the mixture that has begun to set.
construction-chemicals.appSchedule: 1. Dampen the concrete substrate using a wet rag. While the surface is still damp, apply a thin layer of the mixture by using a brush. 2. Wait for at least 1 to 2 hours before applying the second coat. The second coat should be applied counter cross-wise to the first coat. 3. No need to neutralize. Allow for at least 7 days prior to any plastering, topping, or tiling works. For MSDS requests, please email technical@boysen.com.ph Pacific Paint (BOYSEN) Philippines, Inc. Pacific Paint ( BOYSEN ® ) Philippines, Inc. is the leading paint manufacturer in the country, supplying both architectural paints and construction chemicals to both local and international markets.

construction-chemicals.title: Konstrukt™ Tileworks™ K-321 Tile Adhesion Promoter and K-302 All-Purpose Tile Adhesive
construction-chemicals.surfacePrep: Surface should be clean and dry, free from dust, dirt, and other foreign matter. It is important to dampen the substrate prior to the application of the tile adhesive.

construction-chemicals.title: Konstrukt™ Trafficshield™ K-441 Floor Screed
construction-chemicals.surfacePrep: Check and repair all relevant defects by consulting necessary civil works. Always make sure that the surface is clean and dry, free from oil, grease, dust, dirt, and other foreign matters.
construction-chemicals.materialPrep: Put 25-kg of K-441 Floor Screed into a suitable container (like a plastic bucket) and mix it with 3.25 to 3.50 Liters of water until a lump-free homogenous paste is reached.
construction-chemicals.appSchedule: Pour the prepared mixture onto the substrate and distribute it evenly using a smoothening trowel. The mixture should be used within 60 to 90 minutes after mixing. Avoid the addition of water into mixture that has begun to set. Drying time is approximately 3 days prior to the placement of various coverings. For MSDS requests, please email technical@boysen.com.ph Pacific Paint (BOYSEN) Philippines, Inc. industrial-coating.title: BOYSEN ® ® Acqua Epoxy™ Acrylic Water-based Epoxy Paint
BOYSEN ® ® Heat Resisting Aluminum Paint B-95
BOYSEN ® ® Plasolux Primer Surfacer B-307
industrial-coating.surfacePrep: Surface to be painted should be clean and dry, free from dust, dirt, and other foreign matter. Hammer all nails deep enough to apply putty. Sand rough wood until smooth and then dust off before painting. For repainting, scrape off all loose, scaling, flaking, and peeling paint as necessary. Make sure that the surface is clean, dry, and good weather persists prior to painting.

industrial-coating.title: BOYSEN ® ® Powertrack™ Hi-Performance Thermoplastic Road Marking Paint
industrial-coating.surfacePrep: Surface should be clean and dry, free from oil, grease, dirt, contaminants, and all loose grit and mortar.
industrial-coating.materialPrep: Powertrack™ Thermoplastic Road Marking Paint is preheated to 180-220°C, allowing 15 to 20 minutes before application. Maintain required temperatures while constantly stirring. Mixture should be applied within 4 hours.
industrial-coating.appSchedule: 1. Apply suitable primer as required or specified. 2. Using the appropriate hand propelled machine, self-propelled machine, or by hand screed, apply coating at 1.8 to 2.2 mm thickness. Apply succeeding coats to conform to specified coat thickness after the subsequent coat has completely dried. 3. Scatter specified glass beads at recommended loading of 300-400 g/m 2 when the finish coat is at touch-dry stage. 4. Allow finished surfaces to completely dry hard before opening to foot and vehicular traffic.

industrial-coating.title: BOYSEN ® ® Red Oxide Metal Primer B-310
industrial-coating.surfacePrep: Wipe the surface with a rag soaked in paint thinner to remove grease, oil, wax and other foreign matter. For new galvanized surfaces, you may opt to etch the surface by applying 10% BOYSEN ® ® Metal Etching Solution B-71 (Dilute 1 part of B-71 to 9 parts water). Rinse with water and dry immediately. Unpainted galvanized surfaces that have been exposed for 6 months or more need not be etched. For recoating pre-painted galvanized surfaces in good condition, sand lightly then wipe the surface with a clean rag before applying paint. Remove all loose paint film to sound surface. Spot prime bare substrate. For corroded galvanized surfaces, remove rust by wire brushing and use BOYSEN ® ® Metal Etching Solution B-71. Let it stay for 10-15 minutes. Be sure to remove all remaining residue. Immediately prime after drying.

industrial-coating.title: BOYSEN ® ® Rust-Off™ B-330 Gray Alkyd Metal Primer
industrial-coating.surfacePrep: Wipe the surface with a rag soaked in paint thinner to remove grease, oil, wax and other foreign matter. For recoating pre-painted galvanized surfaces in good condition, sand lightly then wipe the surface with a clean rag before applying paint. Remove all loose paint film to sound surface. For corroded galvanized surfaces, remove rust by wire brushing and use BOYSEN ® ® Metal Etching Solution B-71. Let it stay for 10-15 minutes. Be sure to remove all remaining residue. Immediately prime after drying.
